channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Achilles: Legends Untold
item.description: Rewrite fate with every strike. Face gods, mythic heroes, and legendary beasts in this souls-like Action RPG set in ancient Greece. Master brutal combat, unlock divine skills, and shape Achilles into the warrior only you can become.

item.title: Backpack Dungeon
item.description: A unique pixel-art backpack management roguelike. Your backpack isn't just storage—it's your combat core. Item placement, adjacency, and trigger mechanics determine your survival in the dungeon. A mental challenge of spatial planning and strategy.

item.title: Flux Empyrean
item.description: The Flux is not keen on giving away its secrets, and you’re one of them. Sail a vast planet under a blanket of stars and use your tools and wits to remind yourself of what was lost and what could come next. An open world mystery about understanding the end of the world.

item.title: Stay: Your Forever Pet!
item.description: A cozy pet sim where you raise Ember, your magical fox-like companion. Bring her home, care for her, and venture into the Otherlands together -- deepening your bond one adventure at a time.

item.title: SUPER BOMBERMAN COLLECTION
item.description: Party battle game "SUPER BOMBERMAN" is now available as a collection featuring a total of 7 titles with 12 versions across JP, EUR and USA, including the long-awaited localised versions of the unreleased SUPER BOMBERMAN 4 and 5! Including Boss Rush mode, support functions, libraries and more!

item.title: The Outlast Trials - Reagent Starter Pack
item.description: Get ready with the Reagent Starter Pack, which includes exclusive items.

item.title: Three Kingdoms : Alias
item.description: A world where officers hide their names and abilities. Can you spot Zhuge Liang? A hardcore turn-based strategy simulation for true Three Kingdoms devotees.

item.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist : Link Evolution
item.description: Build your Deck from over 10,000 cards and take on the most iconic Duelists from the Yu-Gi-Oh! universe. Relive the stories from the original Yu-Gi-Oh! animated series through Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS!

item.title: Achilles: Survivor
item.description: Thousands of enemies. One survivor. Fight like a demigod, build deadly defenses, and grow stronger after every run in this fast-paced bullet heaven set in mythic Greece.

item.title: Castlevania: Lords of Shadow 2
item.description: Dracula, weak and yearning release from immortality, must reclaim his powers and defeat Satan. An epic fantasy adventure set in an expansive modern-day world!Awoken after centuries of slumber, weakened and yearning for release from his immortal bonds, Dracula must reclaim his powers and make a pact with Death, to defeat Satan and gain...

item.title: Castlevania: Lords of Shadow – Ultimate Edition
item.description: Castlevania: Lords of Shadow – Ultimate Edition is the complete edition of Castlevania: Lords of Shadow, a dark and vivid new re-imagining of the Castlevania mythology. It is the end of days and ungodly powers isolate the Earth.

item.title: Cat Chess - Supporter Cat
item.description: Support Your Crazy Lady (The Developer) and Get Cool Gifts! A whole new cats chess set, chess boards music pack and more

item.title: Contra: Operation Galuga
item.description: The legendary Contra series returns! This reimagining of the classic run-'n'-gun action game from the ‘80s features new stages, new enemies, new play mechanics, and co-op combat for up to 4 players!

item.title: Double Dragon Revive
item.description: The world-famous Double Dragon roars back to life!

item.title: Jusant
item.description: Enjoy meditative vibes in Jusant, an action-puzzle climbing game. Scale an immeasurably tall tower and ascend to new heights alongside your watery companion. Master your climbing tools, find your way up through diverse biomes, and piece together the tower’s past.

item.title: METAL GEAR SOLID 3: Snake Eater - Master Collection Version
item.description: Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater is the origin story of Naked Snake and his mentor The Boss and the fifth title in the METAL GEAR series.

item.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection
item.description: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Cowabunga Collection contains thirteen prior released classic games. This collection is a great place for gamers to experience these popular titles on Steam.

item.title: Uh Oh Airlines
item.description: Serve drinks, wrangle passengers, and survive turbulence in this silly solo or co-op flight attendant simulator. Handle routine cabin duties while everything goes hilariously wrong, from loose pets to spiraling passenger panic. It’s pure cabin chaos at 30,000 feet!

item.title: Bowling Alley Simulator
item.description: Bowling Alley Simulator lets you build, manage, and grow your own bowling alley. Run the lanes, cook classic food, hire staff, and expand your business into a thriving entertainment destination.

item.title: Cat Chess
item.description: Play the ancient and thrilling game of Chess but with... cats! Lead your furry friends to the Purrfect battle of brains and whiskers!

item.title: Cat Chess - Royal Cat (Deluxe Digital Edition)
item.description: Become the best crazy cat lady with this deluxe edition! 2 new Cat Chess sets, boards, music packs and more!

item.title: Celestial Return
item.description: Loot, bribe, gamble, survive. The dice will be your savior or your downfall in this story-driven RPG. Every roll matters when trying to uncover cosmic horrors and outwit megacorps. Pray your next roll won’t be your last.

item.title: D-topia
item.description: Step into the world of D-topia in this gentle-paced puzzle adventure. In D-topia, life is curated by artificial intelligence to maximize happiness. As the newest Facilitator, it’s up to you to solve puzzles to keep the D-topia residents happy and the facility running.

item.title: Factory Town 2: Paradise
item.description: A Town Builder + Factory Sim where you fully automate a tropical village and feed a giant volcano. Use conveyor belts, trains, boats, zip lines, pipes, water wheels and more to produce massive amounts of items and keep everyone happy!

item.title: METAL GEAR & METAL GEAR 2: Solid Snake
item.description: The first and second title in the METAL GEAR series that established the stealth action genre, as well as the basic mechanics of the series.

item.title: METAL GEAR SOLID 2: Sons of Liberty - Master Collection Version
item.description: The fourth game in the METAL GEAR series: set over two incidents in 2007 and 2009, featuring Solid Snake and Raiden, introducing new stealth gameplay features.

item.title: Rock Bottom
item.description: Mine. Smelt. Upgrade. Repeat. Rock Bottom is an incremental mining game where every swing makes you stronger. Descend through 8 unique layers, unlock devastating abilities, and discover what lies at Rock Bottom

item.title: Taival
item.description: Play together on the couch or online - or both at once. Taival is a cozy co-op adventure where you and up to 3 friends explore a handcrafted world alongside your shapeshifting companion. Discover new forms, progress through narrative quests, and make the journey your own.

item.title: The Crimson Maid
item.description: A marriage between first person exploration and visual novel, blessed with a sprinkle of puzzle gameplay. Immerse yourself in a period drama that intertwines romance with murder mystery, as a young cleric who must resist or give in to the charms of a strikingly beautiful maid.

item.title: The Incident at Galley House
item.description: In 1936, something terrible happened at Galley House. Decades later, with a strange contraption that reveals echoes of the past, you must uncover the truth behind this grisly mystery.

item.title: Urban Strife
item.description: Old school TBS, post-apoc survival and RPG. Recruit deranged locals in your militia, ally local factions and fight those you hate. Haul loot back and rebuild your shelter, doctor your wounds, and fix your guns. People need feeding, booze needs brewing and there is an end of the world to enjoy.

item.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION
item.description: Yu-Gi-Oh! EARLY DAYS COLLECTION is packed with classic Yu-Gi-Oh! games from the very early days of Dueling — bursting with retro RPGs and strategic card games with beloved anime characters!
